children: Adobe reported record third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, with revenue of $6.76 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $6.13. The company exited the quarter with total Annualized Recurring Revenue (ARR) of $27.50 billion and reported GAAP net income of $1.83 billion. Adobe also said it achieved more than 1 billion monthly active users across its creativity and productivity solutions.
Total revenue: $6.76 billion for Q3 FY2026 (13% year-over-year growth; 12% in constant currency).
Gross profit: $5,997 million for the three months ended August 28, 2026 (figure shown; gross margin not separately provided).
Operating income: GAAP operating income of $2.35 billion and non-GAAP operating income of $2.97 billion for Q3.
Net income: GAAP net income of $1.83 billion for the quarter; non-GAAP net income of $2.42 billion.
Per-share: GAAP diluted net income per share $4.62; non-GAAP diluted net income per share $6.13.
Total Adobe Ending ARR: Exiting the quarter with Annualized Recurring Revenue of $27.50 billion.

Customer group performance: Business Professionals & Consumers subscription revenue grew to $1.91 billion (16% YoY) and Creative & Marketing Professionals subscription revenue was $4.65 billion (13% YoY).

User growth and product strategy: Reached a milestone of more than 1 billion monthly active users across creativity and productivity solutions; expanding reach via a freemium strategy and agentic AI experiences.
Cash and capital actions: Record Q3 cash flows from operations of $2.52 billion and repurchased approximately 9.5 million shares during the quarter.
Backlog and contract metrics: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) were $22.16 billion with Current RPO (cRPO) at 67% at quarter end.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Adobe reports record Q3 revenue $6.76B, non-GAAP EPS $6.13 and ARR $27.5B
